Question 1
?

A=[−1−230−20−24−8]

Consider the matrix A shown above. What are the dimensions of the eigenspaces V−7 and V−2 corresponding to eigenvalues λ=−7 and λ=−2 of A, respectively?

a
dim(V−7)=0 and dim(V−2)=3
b
dim(V−7)=2 and dim(V−2)=2
c
dim(V−7)=1 and dim(V−2)=2
d
dim(V−7)=2 and dim(V−2)=1
e
dim(V−7)=1 and dim(V−2)=1
